change_summary: The journal issued an expression of concern saying the editors have been made aware of concerns regarding some of the data reported in the article. The matter is being looked into and readers will be updated when more information is available. The notice does not say which data are affected. The stored paper's abstract reports that transplanting gut bacteria from depressed donors made recipient mice less active in a forced-swim test (Figure 3).
evaluation: Your Discussion cites Lopez and Chen [8] as showing reduced activity in recipient mice, supporting a causal role of gut bacteria in depression, and says your proposal builds on this finding. The paper's abstract reports that transplanting gut bacteria from depressed donors made recipient mice less active in a forced-swim test. The journal's expression of concern says the editors have been made aware of concerns regarding some of the data reported in the article, and that the matter is being looked into. The notice does not say which data are affected, so it is uncertain whether the transplant result you rely on is involved. Because this finding is key evidence for your Discussion and the proposal, the impact is medium, though uncertain until the investigation says which data are concerned.
recommendation: Your Discussion cites Lopez and Chen [8] as showing reduced activity in recipient mice, supporting a causal role of gut bacteria in depressive behaviour, and says your proposal builds on this finding. The journal's expression of concern says the editors have been made aware of concerns regarding some of the data reported in the article, but the notice does not say which data are affected. Hedge the wording of that sentence, cite the notice, and avoid building new work on this finding for now. The matter is being looked into and readers will be updated when more information is available. Tracking continues, so a retraction would raise a new alert.
